zh.text: 耶鲁大学位于美国康涅狄格州纽黑文市，是一所私立研究型大学。学校于1701年成立，最初旨在培养神学人才，后扩展至人文与科学教育。19世纪增设研究生与专业学院，并于1861年颁发美国首个博士学位。其学术单位分为12所学院，包括本科学院、文理研究院及专业学院。除市中心主校区外，学校还设有西希文校区及多处自然保育区。

en.text: Yale University is a private research university located in New Haven, Connecticut. Founded in 1701, it initially focused on training ministers in theology and sacred languages. The curriculum expanded to include humanities and sciences by the American Revolution. In the 19th century, the institution added graduate and professional schools, awarding the first U.S. PhD in 1861. Academic units are organized into 12 colleges, including the undergraduate college and graduate schools. The campus includes a central location in New Haven and a western campus with natural conservation areas.
